## Summary

**File Modified:** `AudioRacer-PlayerSimulator/src/at/fhv/audioracer/simulator/gui/StartUpView.java`

**Modifications:**
1. Added a new import statement for `at.fhv.audioracer.core.util.Position`.
2. Updated the method signature of `onUpdateCheckpointDirection()` (an overridden method from the `IPlayerClientListener` interface) to `onUpdateCheckpointDirection(Position pos)`, adding a `Position` parameter.

**Relationship:**
This is a single-file fix addressing a build error caused by an interface mismatch. The `IPlayerClientListener` interface likely was updated elsewhere (not shown in this patch) to require a `Position` parameter in the `onUpdateCheckpointDirection` method. This patch updates the anonymous class implementation in `StartUpView.java` to match the new interface signature, requiring the import of the `Position` class to resolve the type reference. The change ensures the anonymous inner class correctly implements the updated interface contract, fixing the compilation failure.
